definitions.gloss: to join a club; to become a member of a club
definitions.explanation: To formally join a school club or extracurricular activity group. Primarily used in the context of Japanese schools, where club activities ({部活動|ぶかつどう}) are a central part of student life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}した。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}われて→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}した。
examples.english: I was invited by a friend and joined the wind ensemble club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ったら→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}する⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm undecided about which club to join when I start middle school.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate which club one joins: ～⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}する. Primarily a school context word. The opposite is ⟦{退部|たいぶ}→退部：21010_taibu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to quit a club).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}する (to join ~ club)
- {入部届|にゅうぶとどけ} (club membership application form)
- ⟦{入部|にゅうぶ}→入部：11685_nyuubu⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ (wish to join a club)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, joining a club (⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧) is considered an important part of education. Many students join in April at the start of the school year after attending trial sessions ({体験入部|たいけんにゅうぶ}).
